title: Austria Self-employed Key Worker evidence proposal

proposed_rules.statement: The route is for a third-country national whose intended self-employed activity in Austria creates macroeconomic benefit beyond its own operational benefit.

A sustained transfer of investment capital to Austria of at least EUR 100,000 is one stated indicator of macroeconomic benefit; the official source also lists jobs, know-how or new technology, and regional significance as alternative indicators.
The Public Employment Service evaluates the macroeconomic benefit and issues an expertise; the residence authority separately decides the residence application and general requirements still apply.
If issued, the Red-White-Red Card is valid for 24 months and permits the self-employed activity described in the application.

pathway_draft.name: Austria Self-employed Key Worker
required_evidence: Evidence of health insurance covering all risks
Business plan with market, competition and location analysis
Evidence of capital transfer and intended job creation or preservation
Case-specific company agreements or trade authorisations
material_risks: The capital threshold is an indicator, not automatic eligibility
AMS expertise and residence-authority approval are required
Capital and business execution remain at risk
General residence requirements and case-specific evidence apply
Rules, fees and evidence expectations can change before filing
